description: Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms - Order Authorize the Incorporation of the "Trustees of the Society of Jesus in Sri Lanka"
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87). It contains orders made by the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms regarding the incorporation and revocation of incorporation of religious trust entities. The content focuses on statutory instruments (orders under Section 114 of the Trusts Ordinance) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
